lanes.correctness: maximum checking; logging allowed; correctness claims only
lanes.observability: syscall/scheduler/PMU/runtime tracing; observer overhead must be measured
lanes.performance: minimal instrumentation; raw samples retained; no tracing mixed into headline timing

stop_rule: continue from highest urgency unresolved gate to the smallest reproducible next action; stop only when all claim-blocking fields are determined as PASS, FAIL, or an explicitly bounded TOKEN_VAZIO outside the authorized measurement scope

information-security management, risk treatment, controlled evidence and continual improvement
data-quality process, master-data quality metrics, provenance and data-quality strategy

standards_alignment.reference: NIST SP 800-218 SSDF v1.1 and NIST SP 800-53 Rev.5
standards_alignment.use: secure-development practice, configuration, audit/accountability, assessment, integrity and supply-chain controls
normative vocabulary, unambiguous timestamps and canonical JSON for repeatable hashing/signing
Define-Measure-Analyze-Improve-Control as improvement loop; no sigma-level claim without measured defect/opportunity model
